info.text:
A bank booked $13 billion of travel in 2025: Chase Travel, per JPMorgan's 2025 Annual Report (up 12%, and JPMorgan calls it the #3 US consumer leisure travel provider).
Sapphire Reserve's annual fee rose from $550 to $795 in the 2025 refresh.
The card earns 8x points on Chase Travel vs 4x on flights and hotels booked direct; Points Boost can make points worth up to 2 cents on select portal bookings.
The surprise: JPMorgan's card income fell 14% in 2025, to $4.72 billion from $5.50 billion, as rewards costs and partner payments outran spending growth (FY2025 10-K).
Sources: JPMorgan FY2025 10-K and 2025 Annual Report, 4Q25 earnings supplement, NerdWallet, AwardWallet.
News and education, not financial advice.
